jobs.description_text: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. About the Role We’re looking for a product manufacturing engineer, who will be responsible for driving technical initiatives related to manufacturing to ensure product success from concept to launch and through mass production with a specific focus on PCB and PCBa manufacturing and process. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a wide range of stakeholders, from design engineering and operations teams,TPMs, external industry vendors and partners to ensure that all products are developed and delivered on time and to the highest quality standards. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving manufacturing and quality initiatives to ensure product success from concept to launch - Lead the product design and the manufacturing process for next-gen AI hardware system development, you will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of stakeholders, from design engineering and operations teams, TPMs and external industry vendors and partners to ensure that all products are developed and delivered on time and to the highest quality standards. - Lead the team to establish NPI product manufacturing process, systems and quality controls, defining clear milestones and deliverables, drive internal process improvements across multiple terms and functions - Provide hands-on product manufacturing analysis during design, development, testing, prototypes and production phases. - Research automation techniques and develop new tests and systems for efficiency. - Own L6 up to potentially L10 product manufacturing development of the hardware product. This includes the PCB, PCBA, cabling and connectorization & L10 assembly spanning internal and external development work through successful deployment into the infrastructure and support of production workloads at scale - Develop and manage overall product manufacturing requirements, scope, schedules, and deliverables with engineering teams, TPMs, suppliers, partners and key stakeholders - Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of programs - Utilize problem-solving skills to resolve issues and overcome obstacles, perform risk assessment, risk mitigation and change management on projects. - Manage multiple projects simultaneously - Monitor project progress and ensure deadlines and standards are met You might thrive in this role if you: - Have an impressive track record of leading complex projects from concept to production launch and have the ability to work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of programs - Are a creative, detail-oriented, and self-motivated individual looking for an exciting opportunity in the tech industry, this could be the perfect role for you - Stay up to date on industry trends and manufacturing technologies for PCB & PCBa - Like being a close partner with cross-functional teams to understand key design changes requiring validation to accurately integrate engineering validation needs into the overall system build - Have experience driving development timelines for new platform introduction and managing internal review processes - Have significant experience driving creativity, quality, and schedule at multinational JDM/CMs & suppliers - Are deeply familiar with PCB material selection, PCBA, BOM component selection, assembly and rework processes, with all relevant equipment - Know the nightmare that is testing ultra-high speed signals - Are excited by capturing, analyzing, and presenting manufacturing test data - Are keen on corrective actions - Are comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing conditions. People Leadership & Team Management - Lead and mentor a team of engineers to deliver high-quality code and projects. - Provide technical guidance, coaching, and career development planning for team members. - Manage performance through clear goal setting, regular feedback and reviews, and identification of growth opportunities. - Foster a collaborative, innovative, and learning-driven culture. - Recruit and build high-performing engineering teams. Consulting, Clients & Growth - Collaborate with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and lead implementation. - Partner with Sales and Presales teams to shape proposals, solution approaches, and contribute to technical responses and estimations. - Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, and frameworks to scale delivery efficiency. - Support Palo IT thought leadership through research, experimentation, and publication. Must-Have Experience - 10+ years of hands-on software development experience including recent experience in client and team management. - Proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams. - Deep technological expertise in fullstack development. Preferred technologies include ReactJS for frontend development and NodeJS/Java/Python for backend development. - Experience in developing scalable, reliable, and secure applications. - Experience with solution architecture. - Strong understanding of common programming patterns and principles. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. - Demonstrated use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work (not just theoretical exposure). AI-Native & Gen-E2 Skills (Required) - Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalent). - Strong grasp of prompt and context engineering for engineering workflows. - Proven experience defining and enforcing GenAI best practices across teams. - Ability to coach and mentor teams on effective and responsible AI tool usage. - Critical thinking to validate and verify AI-generated code and solutions. Good to Have - Experience with any emerging technologies (Decentralised Identity, Realtime-cross border payment, Quantum computing, Advanced Smart Contract etc..). - Experience with AI/ML services and frameworks. - Experience with cloud computing platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). - Mobile development experience (Swift for iOS, Android, native or hybrid). - Certification in Claude AI (Anthropic) is a plus. What Success Looks Like at Palo IT - You lead high-performing, AI-Native teams. - You own technical direction and deliver production-grade applications with excellence. - You define and enforce best practices across teams and projects. - You grow people, platforms, and impact — together. - You elevate Palo IT's Gen-E2 maturity across teams and clients. You will combine strategic account development, executive relationship building, and ecosystem partnership management, working closely with Microsoft, GitHub, and PALO IT leadership teams around one clear mission: help the world’s largest organizations become AI Frontier Enterprises. 1. You will: - Develop long-term account growth strategies rather than chasing one-off opportunities. - Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and business executives. - Partner closely with delivery, engineering and transformation teams to ensure exceptional client outcomes. - Own commercial performance across your portfolio including forecasting, staffing, profitability and sustainable growth. - Identify opportunities around AI Engineering, AI Transformation, Agentic Organizations, Developer Experience, Product Modernization and AI-enabled SDLC. - Contribute to strategic bids, executive workshops and executive-level client presentations. 2. Grow our AI Partnership Ecosystem (Microsoft, GitHub & future partners) Our partnerships are becoming one of our biggest growth engines. You'll help accelerate them. Initially this means working closely with Microsoft and GitHub before expanding into our broader AI ecosystem. You'll: - Design and execute joint Go-To-Market initiatives. - Identify new business opportunities together with partner teams. - Coordinate executive engagements, client introductions and innovation workshops. - Organize flagship AI events and executive roundtables. - Help position PALO IT as one of the leading AI transformation partners - Build scalable partnership playbooks as our ecosystem expands. 3. Shape the Future of AI Consulting This role isn't only about selling. You'll actively contribute to the evolution of our business. You'll participate in: - Developing next-generation AI offerings - Creating executive thought leadership - Building new commercial playbooks - Refining our Gen-e2™ methodology - Experimenting with AI-native ways of working - Leveraging AI agents to augment sales, partnerships and client engagement Who You Are - 5+ years growing strategic accounts within consulting, digital transformation, technology services or software. - Experienced in working across enterprise and public sector - Proven track record of growing existing accounts, measuring success in client lifetime value rather than single transactions. - AI-first by mindset, passionate about emerging technologies, and able to shape AI-powered solutions that elevate client operations. - Comfortable discussing AI Engineering, Product Development, Cloud, DevOps, Platform Engineering or Enterprise Transformation with senior technology leaders. - Entrepreneurial and naturally proactive, you don't wait for opportunities to appear, you create them. - Structured enough to manage complexity while remaining pragmatic. Bonus points if you've worked with Microsoft, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud or other strategic technology ecosystems. Why join now? AI is creating the biggest shift our industry has experienced in decades. Most consulting firms are still figuring out how to adapt. We're building what comes next. Joining PALO IT today means helping shape: - the future of AI-Native consulting, - the future of software engineering, - and the future of enterprise transformation. If you're excited by building businesses, working with world-class technology partners, and helping large organizations navigate one of the most important technology shifts of our generation, we'd love to meet you. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world's most complex challenges. jobs.description_text: About Plaud Inc. Plaud is building the real-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 3,000,000 users worldwide since 2023. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity. Plaud Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated, San Francisco-based company. With GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and EN 18031 compliance, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection. To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/plaud_official/, X https://twitter.com/PLAUDAI, Facebook https://www.facebook.com/plaudai, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/plaudai/, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@PLAUDAI. Why You Should Join Us Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think. - Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years. - Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction. - Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion. - Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success. - Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development. - Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere. What you will do - Own large-scale speech/audio data pipelines: build and maintain systems for data collection, cleaning, filtering, labeling, augmentation and quality control to support model training. Partner with senior speech engineers on term/hotword mining strategies based on ASR system output. - Support model training and optimization: contribute to fine-tuning and evaluating speech/language models (SpeechLLM or general LLM background both applicable), with focus on improving recognition accuracy for code-switching, names, and product terms — working alongside domain specialists on the technical algorithm design. - Domain adaptation: help fine-tune models using scenario-specific data to improve recognition of industry-specific terms across key languages and verticals. - Evaluation: build test sets and evaluation frameworks (keyword/domain-lexicon based); benchmark internal models against open-source and commercial baselines. Skills, qualifications and experience we look for - Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in speech, machine learning, or large-scale data engineering. - Experience in AT LEAST ONE of the following: a) ASR/SpeechLLM model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation; b) LLM or general ML model training/fine-tuning; c) Large-scale audio, video, or text data pipeline work (e.g., tens of thousands of hours of audio, or TB-scale multimodal data). - Solid Python and PyTorch fundamentals. - Experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark, Ray) — moved up from nice-to-have, since responsibility #1 requires pipeline ownership at scale. Nice-to-Have: - Familiarity with SpeechLLM / speech SSL concepts, or exposure to models such as StepAudio or Qwen3-Omni. - Prior experience building or contributing to hotword/contextual-biasing or code-switching ASR improvements. - Publications at Interspeech, ICASSP, or other top AI venues, or speech-related patents. - Experience owning a data workstream (tens/hundreds of thousands of hours of speech) in a speech-model training project. What we offer - Meaningful Ownership An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) that gives a real stake in Plaud’s long-term success. - High-Impact Environment Work in a fast-moving, product-driven environment where your ideas directly shape the future of AI productivity. - Cutting-Edge AI Tools for Productivity Access to best-in-class AI tools, including Gemini, Claude Code, and other frontier AI systems to maximize engineering and execution efficiency. - Best-in-Class Equipment Choice of top-spec laptops, high-performance workstation setups, and cutting-edge Plaud devices for all new hires. - Team & Culture Annual company offsites, team events, and a culture that values craftsmanship, ownership, and velocity. - Medical & Insurance Coverage Comprehensive benefits to protect our employees' financial security, physical health, and longterm growth. Medical insurance and WICA coverage for all full-time employees. Disclaimer: Plaud is and will continue to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description_text: Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones) Start Date: ASAP Languages: English Team: Engineering ABOUT THE ROLE Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand. We are looking for a Research Engineer, Synthetic Data to build the synthetic data pipeline. You will turn domain-specific workflows into synthetic training tasks that are realistic enough to teach useful behaviour, structured enough to generate at scale, and difficult enough to expand model capabilities. This is a hands-on research engineering seat, not a commercial or privacy-systems role. You will design how synthetic tasks are created, mutated and validated, and you will analyse what those tasks actually teach models and agents. This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70–80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Work with subject-matter experts to create synthetic tasks for training AI agents across a range of professional and technical domains. - Design synthetic task-generation methods that produce diverse, realistic and learnable tasks. - Build systems and tooling to mutate, validate and improve synthetic tasks. - Analyse model and agent performance on synthetic tasks to understand what the tasks are teaching and where they fail. - Develop metrics to quantify and understand synthetic task diversity, realism, learnability and related qualities. - Take synthetic data pipelines from early research through to reliable systems, including in areas where the roadmap is not fully prescribed. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proficiency in Python, Docker and Linux environments. - Experience with synthetic data research methods — please be ready to describe this in your application. - A strong understanding of what “good synthetic data” means, and of its limitations. - Experience building synthetic data pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap. - Experience working on environments, evals or benchmarks. - Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating remotely across time zones. - Strong candidates may also be detail-oriented enough to catch subtle inconsistencies or edge cases in synthetic data; able to reason from first principles about task design, scoring and failure modes; and comfortable in unstructured problem spaces or early-stage environments. - Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS FOR YOU - Build the synthetic data pipeline: You will design the tasks and systems that generate training data at scale, not only run experiments on someone else's pipeline. - Research that has to work in production: Turn messy, domain-specific workflows into tasks that are realistic, measurable and usable for training agents. - See what the data actually teaches: Analyse model and agent performance, and improve the tasks when they fail. - High ownership, unstructured problems: You will build without a fully prescribed roadmap, from method design through tooling and metrics. - San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70–80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
